mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_id, location_id, sku_id, lot_no, inventory_status, on_hand_qty, available_qty, reserved_qty, frozen_qty, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM wms_inventory WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND location_id = #{locationId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND lot_no = #{lotNo} AND inventory_status = #{inventoryStatus} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_inventory SET on_hand_qty = #{entity.onHandQty}, available_qty = #{entity.availableQty}, reserved_qty = #{entity.reservedQty}, frozen_qty = #{entity.frozenQty}, version = #{entity.version}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{oldVersion} AND deleted = 0 AND on_hand_qty >= 0 AND available_qty >= 0 AND reserved_qty >= 0 AND frozen_qty >= 0
